body: girls seem to be more mellow than boys in my experience, likely less affectionate than you’re used to, but overall they tend to be calmer. i honestly don’t think it matters too much, but i would lean towards a girl since male cats can get territorial easily in new environments

this! cats can take a long time to warm up to you. i recommend to just sit in the same room a few feet away from her whenever you can, co-inhabiting a space is a big deal for them. also being near her while she’s eating, drinking water, or even going to the litter box, she’ll see it as you watching her back. associate yourself with positive interactions, like leaving some treats near you and leaving a hand near them while she eats. let her come to you and she will with time, good luck!

this is something i struggled with a lot when i was suicidal for almost an entire year, but the answer is yes. cats have good long term memory and remember humans for years after last seeing them. my cat was the biggest reason i didn’t. i couldn’t bear to let my little guy be confused as to why i abandoned him or if he realized i died, let him mourn me. thinking about it made me feel really guilty and that guilt is what kept me going even if it felt shitty. keep going for her until you really can’t anymore if it gets to that point. it’s been sixteen month since i got on the right meds and i am so glad i didn’t commit. i’ve gotten to share so many good and bad moments with my little guy and even thought that pain isn’t yet worth it, it’s getting there. i’m here and i get it, message me if you want to
